subject: sprintf() function is not displaying properly in ggplot

messages.author: 4b890229d8cfaf55
messages.subject: sprintf() function is not displaying properly in ggplot
parts:
Hello again, I am facing a problem where the sprintf() function is not
displaying properly. Let say, I have following ggplot:

Dat <- structure(list(Date = structure(c(1L, 2L, 3L, 4L, 5L, 1L, 2L,
3L, 4L, 5L, 1L, 2L, 3L, 4L, 5L), .Label = c("12-03-2012", "12-04-2012",
"12-05-2012", "12-06-2012", "12-07-2012"), class = "factor"),
OBJ = structure(c(1L, 1L, 1L, 1L, 1L, 2L, 2L, 2L, 2L, 2L,
3L, 3L, 3L, 3L, 3L), .Label = c("OBJ 1", "OBJ 2", "OBJ 3"
), class = "factor"), Time = c(11, 11.25, 11.35, 12.01, 11.14,
13, 13.25, 13.35, 14.01, 13.14, 14.5, 14.75, 14.85, 15.51,
14.64)), .Names = c("Date", "OBJ", "Time"), class = "data.frame",
row.names = c(NA,
-15L));

p <- ggplot(Dat) + geom_line(aes(y = Time, x =
as.numeric(as.Date(Dat$Date, format = "%m-%d-%Y")), color = OBJ), size
= 3) +
ylab(NULL) + xlab(NULL) +
scale_x_continuous(labels = function(x) sprintf("%1.0f/",
as.numeric(format(as.Date(x, format = "%m-%d-%Y"), "%y"))))
p


In the X-axis, all labels are coming as NA. Can somebody correct me
where I gone wrong? If I use sprintf() function stand-alone basis then
everything is coming perfect:

x <- Dat[1,1]
sprintf("%1.0f/", as.numeric(format(as.Date(x, format = "%m-%d-%Y"), "%y")))

# "12/"

Thanks for your input.

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: sprintf() function is not displaying properly in ggplot
parts:
Hi:

I'm guessing you're looking for scale_x_date(). Here are a couple of
ways you could go:

ggplot(Dat, aes(x = date, y = Time, color = OBJ)) +
geom_line(size = 3) +
labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
scale_x_date()

last_plot() + scale_x_date(labels = date_format("%m/%d"))

Don't worry about the warning re changing the default labelling in the
second plot. If neither of those is what you want, replace the date
format given above with your own.

Dennis

Hello Dennis,

The main problem to directly working with Date is, it does not accept
'Inf'. To explain better, let say I work with numerical x-axis and Inf

Dat <- structure(list(Date = structure(c(1L, 2L, 3L, 4L, 5L, 1L, 2L,
3L, 4L, 5L, 1L, 2L, 3L, 4L,
5L), .Label = c("12-03-2012", "12-04-2012",
"12-05-2012", "12-06-2012",
"12-07-2012"), class = "factor"),
OBJ = structure(c(1L,
1L, 1L, 1L, 1L, 2L, 2L, 2L, 2L, 2L,
3L, 3L, 3L, 3L, 3L),
.Label = c("OBJ 1", "OBJ 2", "OBJ 3"
), class = "factor"),
Time = c(11, 11.25, 11.35, 12.01, 11.14,
13, 13.25, 13.35,
14.01, 13.14, 14.5, 14.75, 14.85, 15.51,
14.64)), .Names =
c("Date", "OBJ", "Time"), class = "data.frame",
row.names = c(NA,
-15L));

p <- ggplot(Dat) + geom_line(aes(y = Time, x =
as.numeric(as.Date(Dat$Date, format = "%m-%d-%Y")), color = OBJ), size
= 3) +

annotate("rect", xmin = c(-Inf, max(as.numeric(as.Date(Dat$Date,
format = "%m-%d-%Y"))), -Inf, -Inf),
xmax = c(min(as.numeric(as.Date(Dat$Date, format =
"%m-%d-%Y"))), Inf, Inf, Inf),
ymin = c(-Inf, -Inf, -Inf, max(Dat$Time)),
ymax = c(Inf, Inf, min(Dat$Time), Inf), color = "grey76")
p

However there will be error if I use Date variable as well as Inf.

Therefore I thought that, I will work with the Numerical x-axis
however represent the axis-ticks as date so that user can easily
understand that.

Can there be some suggestion how I can achieve that?

Thanks and regards,
